text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Hosted API (us-west-2) experiencing cascade of 429s and intermittent 504s starting 02:10 UTC. Root cause preliminary: rate-limit backfill job overloaded ingress token buckets, causing client-facing throttles. Impact ~1.5-4% of requests. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2405008888

riley.sre: seeing token-bucket refill flood from backfill-worker-3. ingress reports high reject counts and some downstream timeouts as retries pile up.

marta.eng: confirmed a scheduled backfill job (job-id: backfill-2026-03-23-02) kicked off without the new backpressure guard. it's issuing high bursts to /v1/generate.

riley.sre: started emergency throttle on backfill queue and paused job at 02:13 UTC. steering new traffic to warmed pools.

henry.support: drafting customer note: "We're investigating increased 429/504 responses for a subset of hosted requests in US-WEST. Mitigation in progress." Publish when we have stable trend.

marta.eng: deploying a hotfix to the backfill worker (add leaky-bucket smoothing + jitter) now. deploy-bot: Action: backfill-worker rollback + patch applied by marta.eng @ 02:17 UTC.

riley.sre: enabling ingress circuit-breaker for backfill user-agent to limit bursty retries at 02:18 UTC. observed immediate drop in rejects.

henry.support: should we proactively notify impacted accounts?

zara.pm: yes send to impacted customers + account teams. note: no data loss, transient throttles only.

marta.eng: patch rolled, backfill job resumed under new smoothing config at 02:22 UTC. error rate trending from ~3.8% -> 0.6% at 02:30 UTC.

riley.sre: monitoring for stability window. expect cache warm and retry backoff to clear in ~15-25m.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Metrics returned to baseline (~0.2% errors) at 02:42 UTC. Mitigation summary: paused backfill, applied burst-smoothing patch, enabled ingress circuit-breaker for backfill UA, resumed job with limits. No customer data loss. Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-24 10:00 UTC in #incidents-postmortems. Runbook: https://status.redwood.ai/runbooks/backfill-flood-mitigation

henry.support: customer-facing note posted and shared with account teams.

zara.pm: thanks all. please capture timeline, config diff, and long-term guard (job scheduling + circuit-breaker by default) in the postmortem. owners: riley.sre (ops timeline), marta.eng (root cause + fix), henry.support (customer comms). :white_check_mark:
